basics.name: Alex Morgan
basics.label: Full Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Full stack software engineer with 5 years of experience building scalable web applications. Passionate about clean code, user experience, and continuous learning. Experienced in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms. Enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that solve real-world problems.

work.name: TechCorp Solutions
work.summary: Lead development of the company's main web application serving 50,000+ users. Work closely with product managers and designers to implement new features and improve user experience.
work.description: Mid-size B2B SaaS company providing project management tools
highlights: Led migration from JavaScript to TypeScript, improving code quality and reducing bugs by 35%
Implemented real-time collaboration features using WebSockets, increasing user engagement by 40%
Optimized database queries and API endpoints, reducing average page load time from 3.2s to 1.1s
Mentored 2 junior developers and conducted regular code reviews
Established automated testing practices, achieving 80% code coverage

work.name: StartupHub Inc
work.summary: Founding engineer responsible for building the initial product from scratch. Worked across the entire stack and collaborated directly with founders on product decisions.
work.description: Early-stage startup building a developer tools platform
highlights: Built MVP in 4 months using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL
Implemented authentication system with OAuth2 and JWT
Developed REST API serving 10,000+ requests per day
Set up CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker
Grew application from 0 to 5,000 active users

work.name: Digital Innovations LLC
work.summary: Developed client websites and web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks. Collaborated with designers to implement pixel-perfect responsive designs.
work.description: Digital agency creating custom web solutions for clients
highlights: Built 8 client websites using React and Next.js
Integrated third-party APIs including Stripe, SendGrid, and Google Maps
Implemented responsive designs achieving 100% mobile compatibility

projects.name: DevTools Dashboard

Integrates with GitHub, Jira, and other developer tools via APIs
Gained 1,200+ GitHub stars and 50+ contributors
Featured on Product Hunt and Hacker News
⭐ 1200 GitHub stars

references.name: Sarah Chen
references.reference: I had the pleasure of managing Alex for two years at TechCorp Solutions. Alex consistently delivered high-quality code and showed great initiative in improving our development processes. Their ability to mentor junior developers while maintaining their own productivity was impressive. Alex would be a valuable asset to any engineering team.

references.name: Michael Rodriguez
references.reference: Alex was one of our founding engineers at StartupHub and played a crucial role in getting our product off the ground. They have a rare combination of technical skills and product sense. Alex can work independently, make good technical decisions, and isn't afraid to ask questions when needed. Highly recommended.
